description: Open an upload for the user's own images, videos, audio or fonts that are not at a public https link (attachments, files in your sandbox), so create_hcmotion can pack them inside the .hcmotion (binary, max 150 MB per file, 200 MB per project). Takes the files' ids (the ones layers will use as props.asset) and returns: script, a shell function to send each file in parts with curl (needs network access to mcp.hypercodemotion.com); part and done, the endpoints it uses (POST raw bytes of up to partBytes per part, then done); page, a link where the user drops the files in a browser; and upload, the code to put in create_hcmotion media as {id, upload}. Try the script first; if your shell cannot reach the host, give the user page and wait until they say the files are in. The upload lasts 24 hours.

files.description: One entry per file: id (letters, digits, . - _; what layers use as props.asset) and optional name (what the user calls it, shown on the drop page).
